facts.function: gear box transmitting drive in a fertilizer spreader

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8483 names gear boxes and other speed changers
Section XVI note 2(a): parts that are themselves goods of a heading of chapter 84/85 go in their own heading, not in 8432.90 parts
GRI 6: 8483.40 gear boxes; 8483.40.50 other than for paper machines; .10 fixed ratio (assumed)

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of fertilizer distributors; excluded because a gear box is itself a good of heading 8483 (Sec. XVI note 2(a))
only for pulp or paper machinery

missing_facts: Is the gearbox fixed-ratio (assumed) or variable-ratio? (affects only the statistical suffix)
classification.rationale: A gearbox assembly is a good of heading 8483 and under Section XVI note 2(a) is classified there rather than as a part of the spreader in 8432. Statistical suffix assumes a fixed-ratio unit. No ruling on point retrieved.
